notes.title: Stealth Fest Is Here, Death To Spies: Moment of Truth Is Now 85% Off
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Steam Stealth Fest has snuck up on us and brought some huge discounts along. From today until July 31, [b]you can get Death To Spies: Moment of Truth with 85% discount[/b].

And that's not all, more Fulqrum Publishing games, specifically [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/406720/Alekhines_Gun/]Alekhine's Gun[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/9800/Death_to_Spies/]Death To Spies[/url], are discounted by 85% as well. There has never been a better deal!

All of these games are also parts of a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15895/Death_To_Spies_123_bundle/]bundle[/url] where another 15% discount applies, meaning you can combine the deals and get all three games together for an incredibly low price! This is in effect even if you already own some of the games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15895/Death_To_Spies_123_bundle/

notes.title: Death To Spies: Moment of Truth is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Death To Spies: Moment of Truth is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Indie Gala 7 now available
notes.content:
Another set of cheap indie games has been bundled up to help you through the summer slump. The seventh Indie Gala bundle is offering three games with a fourth to be unveiled later, along with even more bonus games for paying more than the rolling target average.

The three games in the bundle include Rig'n'Roll, Space Rangers, and Reign: Conflict of Nations. The fourth game is still under wraps, and will be announced in the second week of the sale. If you pay more than the average (currently around $6.90), you also snag Death to Spies, Death to Spies: Moment of Truth, King's Bounty: Armored Princess, and UFO: Afterlight, plus another game to be announced. All in all you could score nine games out of this deal.

Your funds can go towards the disabilities organization AbleGamers and the Italian Red Cross to assist with earthquake relief.
